def utcnow() -> datetime:

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(amt="1000.00"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# idempotency: same key returns same record, no double apply
p = mk()
r1 = refund_shipping(p, "10.00", T0, idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = refund_shipping(p, "10.00", T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is r2 and p.refunded_amount == Decimal("10.00"), p.refunded_amount
assert len(audit.events("shipping_refunded")) == 1
assert audit.events("shipping_refunded")[0]["idempotency_key"] == "k1"

# approval required above 500
p = mk()
try:
    refund_shipping(p, "500.01", T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "approval_required"
# exactly 500 ok
refund_shipping(p, "500.00", T0)
# with approval ok
refund_shipping(p, "500.01", T0, approved_by="mgr")

# full refund sets status
p = mk("100.00")
refund_shipping(p, "100.00", T0)
assert p.status == "refunded"

# exceeds captured
p = mk("100.00")
try:
    refund_shipping(p, "100.01", T0, approved_by="mgr")
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "refund_exceeds_captured"

# non-positive
p = mk()
try:
    refund_shipping(p, "0", T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "non_positive_amount"

# idempotency checked before state validation
p = mk()
